# Anne Mette Falstie-Jensen

Anne Mette Falstie-Jensen is an epidemiologist with a doctorate (ph.d.) serving as a member of the steering committee for [[danibd|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease. She represents epidemiological and data management support from [[rkkp|RKKP]] (the Danish Clinical Quality Program) to the steering group.

According to the 2023 DANIBD annual report, Falstie-Jensen held the position of Epidemiolog, ph.d. at RKKP [^src1]. By the 2024 report, her title had advanced to Seniorepidemiolog, ph.d., and she was listed under SundK (the IT organization supporting Danish health data) [^src2]. Her role places her among the steering committee members who represent medicine, surgery, nursing, and patient representation across all five Danish regions, as well as epidemiological and data management support [^src3].

The broader context of her work is significant: during the period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, DANIBD treated a total of 33,381 patients with inflammatory bowel disease across Danish regions, with biologic treatments (BMSL) administered to 10,523 patients [^src3]. Falstie-Jensen's epidemiological expertise supports the database's documented coverage rate, which likely exceeds 90 percent based on validation against regional databases [^src3].
